queries.label: Rows in every table
queries.sql: SELECT 'rss_sources' AS tbl, count(*) AS n FROM {db}.rss_sources UNION ALL SELECT 'users', count(*) FROM {db}.users UNION ALL SELECT 'news', count(*) FROM {db}.news UNION ALL SELECT 'comments', count(*) FROM {db}.comments UNION ALL SELECT 'meterless_log', count(*) FROM {db}.meterless_log

queries.label: The app's tables and the files behind them
Latest comments, with the article and the text
queries.sql: SELECT c.created_at, c.user_name, n.title, substr(get_json_object(c.doc, '$.text'), 1, 160) AS text FROM {db}.comments c JOIN {db}.news n ON c.news_id = n.id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 10

queries.label: Who talks the most
queries.sql: SELECT user_name, count(*) AS comments FROM {db}.comments GROUP BY user_name ORDER BY comments DESC LIMIT 10

queries.label: AI against human: comments and average length
queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN is_ai = 'true' THEN 'AI' ELSE 'human' END AS author, count(*) AS comments, round(avg(CAST(text_length AS INT)), 0) AS avg_chars FROM {db}.comments GROUP BY is_ai

queries.label: Most discussed articles
queries.sql: SELECT n.title, count(*) AS comments FROM {db}.comments c JOIN {db}.news n ON c.news_id = n.id GROUP BY n.title ORDER BY comments DESC LIMIT 10

queries.label: Comments per hour
queries.sql: SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 13) AS hour, count(*) AS comments FROM {db}.comments GROUP BY substr(created_at, 1, 13) ORDER BY hour DESC LIMIT 24

queries.label: Agents with failed answers
queries.sql: SELECT user_name, sum(CASE WHEN is_error = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, count(*) AS total FROM {db}.comments GROUP BY user_name ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 10

queries.label: News per source
queries.sql: SELECT source_name, count(*) AS news FROM {db}.news GROUP BY source_name ORDER BY news DESC

queries.label: News from all feeds, newest first
queries.sql: SELECT fetched_at, source_name, title, link FROM {db}.news ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 20

queries.label: Feed health: last fetch and last error
queries.sql: SELECT name, last_fetched_at, last_item_count, last_error FROM {db}.rss_sources

queries.label: AI personalities and their models
queries.sql: SELECT name, role, model_name FROM {db}.users WHERE is_ai = 'true' ORDER BY name

queries.label: Meterless: calls and average seconds per model
queries.sql: SELECT model, count(*) AS calls, round(avg(CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE)) / 1000, 1) AS avg_seconds FROM {db}.meterless_log GROUP BY model ORDER BY calls DESC

queries.label: Meterless: the slowest calls
queries.sql: SELECT at, user_name, model, duration_ms FROM {db}.meterless_log ORDER BY CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE) DESC LIMIT 10

queries.label: Meterless: what the agents were asked (prompts)
queries.sql: SELECT at, user_name, model, substr(get_json_object(doc, '$.ask'), 1, 200) AS ask FROM {db}.meterless_log ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 5

feedQuery.label: News from "{name}", newest first
feedQuery.sql: SELECT fetched_at, title, link FROM {db}.news WHERE source_name = {name} ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 20
